text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and D to lock in gains did not stop them rising afterward; I should not let satisfaction from a realized gain replace a forward-looking decision.","Buying B and D back at higher prices reminds me that reacting to regret can lead to costly trades; I should not chase prices or treat past moves as signals.","I should assess each position by its future risk and return, not whether it is above or below my average cost, and keep diversification in view."]}
